title: Verbs of Emotion with the Subjunctive

sections.content:
When you react emotionally to someone else's state or actions, the subordinate clause takes the subjunctive:

• Me alegra que estés aquí. (I'm glad that you are here.)
• Siento que no puedas venir. (I'm sorry that you can't come.)
• Me molesta que hagan tanto ruido. (It bothers me that they make so much noise.)

sections.title: Emotional Reaction Formulas
rows: Me alegra que te guste el regalo.
Tengo miedo de que pierdan el tren.
